title: Steve Ditko
description: "I don't understand how that is meant," answers Steve Ditko when asked what inspired him to do this STAR WARS rendering. "The card situation was given to me to illustrate." Ditko is one of the most respected names in the comic book cosmos, having pioneered the visual styles of classic Marvel characters like THE AMAZING SPIDER-MAN and DR. STRANGE, as well as creating characters of his own, such as the critically-acclaimed MR. A. Recently, he rendered Jack Kirby's SECRET CITY SAGA for Topps Comics.
